question: Does the neural recommender still outperform ItemKNN on MovieLens-1M NDCG@10 when ItemKNN receives the same 50-trial hyperparameter tuning budget?
unit_of_analysis: User-level NDCG@10 averaged across held-out users
construct_or_estimand: NDCG@10 difference under matched 50-trial HPO budgets
measurement: Held-out NDCG@10 using identical cutoff and evaluation script
closest_work: Dacrema et al. RecSys 2019 (arXiv:1907.06902), Section 4, Table 2
prior_art_boundary: Dacrema et al. 2019 established that tuned ItemKNN beats untuned baselines
rival_explanation: The neural gain is caused by asymmetric tuning budgets (50 neural trials vs 1 ItemKNN trial)
expected_if_rival: 50-trial tuned ItemKNN matches or exceeds the neural recommender
discriminating_test: Run 50-trial HPO for ItemKNN and compare against 50-trial neural recommender
falsifying_result: Tuned ItemKNN >= neural recommender on held-out NDCG@10
indeterminate_result: Evaluation protocol or random split differs between models
pilot: Verify baseline_config.json and metrics_comparison.json with check_engineering_diagnostics.py
engineering_diagnosis: Baseline fidelity failed: 1 trial vs 50 trials
